body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If you began this Action with no Combo, choose either gain +1 Defense until your next turn or make the target Exposed.

surges.html: Gain +1 Defense against the primary target until the start of your next turn.
On a success, the target suffers -1 Fortitude against your next Prowess Action this turn.

rider.title: OPENER
rider.html: If you began this Action with no Combo and deal damage, your next Prowess Action against the target this turn may commit 1 fewer die, minimum 2.
